test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 28 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 4.
solution:
The correct answer is '**records**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The sentence "We have (4)_________________ of attacks on humans in Bali from the early 20th century and across much of Java until the 1950s" indicates the existence of documented evidence or accounts of these past events.
 
• "**Records**" (अभिलेख/रिकॉर्ड) refers to information or data preserved for future reference, especially that which is formally registered or documented. This aligns perfectly with the context of historical accounts of attacks.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

Complete Passage: *Saltwater crocodiles are also known as estuarine crocodiles, as they (1) **prefer **__to live in mangrove lined rivers. They’re the (2) __**largest **__living reptile, reaching up to seven metres in length: far larger than Indonesia’s famous Komodo dragon, which tops out at three metres. (3) __**Historically**__, crocodiles lived throughout the Indonesian archipelago. We have (4)__records__ of attacks on humans in Bali from the early 20th century and across much of Java until the 1950s. Even Indonesia’s capital, Jakarta, had crocodile’s (5)____________________in many rivers running through the city.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• **Option 1: "recipes"** (व्यंजनों) are instructions for preparing food, which is irrelevant here.
 
• **Option 3: "regiments"** (रेजिमेंट) are military units, which is also irrelevant to documented attacks by animals.
 
• **Option 4: "residues"** (अवशेष) are small amounts of something that remain after the main part has gone. This does not fit the context of documenting events.
